instruction: Access the customer support contact page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the customer contact/support page. Evaluator verifies URL contains the contact page path.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic can semantically verify that the instruction has been completed correctly
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks for the URL pattern 'united.com/en/us/contact' which correctly verifies access to the United Airlines customer support contact page
Correct data flow: Result type 'active_tab_info' returns tab information including URL, and the metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly extracts and validates the URL
Semantically correct expected value: The pattern 'united.com/en/us/contact' matches the actual United Airlines contact page URL structure
Sound metric logic: The metric correctly handles both string and dict URL formats, uses regex pattern matching, and returns appropriate scores
Practically feasible: The getter can access the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, and the metric can perform regex matching at runtime
